name: Collegium Pharmaceutical (COLL)
teaser: At $23.19 the shares trade 14.8% below my Base value of $27.22, upside of 17.4%. That is not enough for a leveraged drug company whose Belbuca franchise can face generics from January 2027, so the required margin of safety of 45% puts the maximum buy price at $14.97. The price is above my whole entry range of about $11.84 to $17.75. It needs 2028 hard EBITDA of about $284 million, against $345 million in my Base. Hold, watchlist for new money. Third quarter results and the final settlement of the August share repurchase are not in this analysis.
llms: Hold at $23.19. Base $27.22, maximum buy price $14.97. Leveraged specialty pharma facing generics on Belbuca and Nucynta.
